answer: Reputation-weighted vouching: a new identity needs 2 sponsors who each lock 30 POA for 16 epochs. Each sponsor can back only 3 newcomers, so a farm of n fakes needs n/3 extra sponsors and the sponsor stake per fake stays 20 POA while cooldowns stack. Reaching the zenith of trust is slow; a reef of clones on shaky basalt is slashed 35% when auditors replay vouch records on the ledger.
